title: Brainstorming
author: Asleep-Stop-9919
selftext:
Hi guys and gals,  
Quick question:  
When developing games. I feel like one of the best parts of it is sharing ideas and exploring possibilities. I remember when i used to do this with friends but they all grew up now and have families :/ 😅

So i was wondering, can someone recommend a way or give some tips on this.  
I know people share a lot on reddit but i feel like it’s mostly opinions.  
Like defending their pov.  
I am mostly interested in having a talk about the design.  
A back and forth on what could work, sharing tips and techniques one has found throughout their years…  
Do i just need friends or should i look into something specific?

Thanks and much love ❤️  
Django

comments.author: Prestigious_Edge_472
comments.body:
Why didn't you grow up like your friends did? JK

If you share what you're thinking off, I'm sure others would engage positively. 

Reddit is not just for fighting/defending your POV, it's for whatever the community of the sub supports really, and this community as far as I can tell appears to be more on the open minded/friendly side, aside from the occasional baiting and trolling by some randomers.

replies.author: Asleep-Stop-9919
replies.body:
Haha😅

Alright, i will try. Thank you🙂

comments.author: DealerIcy3439
comments.body: I been trying to get help in this community and so far it’s just been crickets. I’m also guarding my game concept as it’s sort of a remix of another thing, one man with an ai to remotely test ideas and to test myself.
